app_fee.value: The graduate application fee at Indiana University Indianapolis is $70 USD.
app_fee.quote: The Graduate Admissions Committee will review applications when all required materials are submitted and received and the $70 application fee is paid by the deadlines indicated.

also.quote: The application fee for all applicants is $70.

fee_waiver.value: Application fee waivers are available to participants in qualifying fellowship and pathway programs such as McNair Scholars, LSAMP, SROP, AmeriCorps, Fulbright, and Peace Corps.
fee_waiver.quote: You may be eligible for a fee waiver (coupon code) if you have participated in one of the following programs. You must send proof of participation by email to gradpsy@iu.edu before completing the application to receive a coupon code.

gre_general.value: GRE General Test requirements are determined by individual graduate programs; see each program record.

also.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE), which is administered by ETS, is a computer-based test designed to measure quantitative, analytical, and language abilities. Your specific graduate program website will indicate their GRE requirements.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score of 4.0 on the January 2026 new scale (79 on the 0-120 scale); some schools and departments require higher scores (80 or 90).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT or TOEFL iBT Home Edition | School code: 1325 | 79 | TOEFL iBT or TOEFL iBT Home Edition New Scoring, as of January 2026 | School code: 1325 | 4.0

ielts_min.value: Minimum overall IELTS band score of 6.5 (7.0 for select Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering doctoral programs).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS, IELTS Online or IELTS Indicator | 6.5

english_waiver.value: English proficiency testing is waived for applicants holding a bachelor's or graduate degree from an accredited U.S. institution or an officially recognized university in a designated country where English is the predominant native language.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who hold a bachelor's degree or a graduate degree from an accredited university in the U.S. or an officially recognized university in a country where English is the predominant native language will be deemed proficient.

also.quote: Degree from an English-speaking country | Equivalent of a US bachelor's degree or higher from one of these designated countries (both lists)

notes: Following the July 2024 realignment of IUPUI, Indiana University Indianapolis confers STEM Ph.D. degrees across the School of Science, the Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering at Indianapolis, and the IU School of Medicine in Indianapolis.
